notes: VAT 14% (VAT Act 2026, s.7(2)). Bullion EXEMPT: Schedule 2 makes a supply of a precious metal exempt - defined as gold in any form at fineness >=99.5% and silver >=99.9% - so investment-grade bullion is 0 for both metals; jewellery alloys below those thresholds take 14%. Import duty 0%: BURS tariff book ch. 71 rates all HS 7108 lines free (pages carry 2009/2012 stamps).
